public_footer: This page shows what {name} has chosen to publish. Their discussions, drafts and internal records are not here.
public_subtitle: Governance, published by the community itself
public_provisional: Rules adopted before this community had agreed how it makes decisions: {count}
public_nothing_published: This community has not published any of its governance documents yet.
public_not_decided: Not yet decided by this community.
public_local_note: Rules this community wrote for itself, which {standard} does not ask for.
public_about_body: This community governs itself against {standard} v{version}, an open standard for community governance. What appears here is what they chose to publish; their discussions, drafts and member records are private to them.
publishing_nothing_publishable: Nothing yet — an artifact becomes publishable once you have adopted at least one of its sections.
publishing_activity: What has been published, and when
publishing_no_activity: Nothing has been published or withdrawn yet.
language_heading: The language this community works in
language_intro: One language for everybody here. Governance is a shared activity, and two members reading the same rule in two languages is how a disagreement becomes an argument about translation.
language_unchanged: This changes what the interface and the standard are shown in. It changes nothing the community wrote — every definition, decision and rationale stays in the words it was written in.
language_saved: Saved. Every member sees this community in the new language.
language_steward_only: Only a steward can change this.
account_erase_what_goes: Your name, your email address and anything you set about yourself are deleted, along with every way of signing in. This cannot be undone.
account_erase_what_stays: What your communities decided stays. Decisions name a membership rather than a person, so your part of the record continues to read as a former member — which is why the count of who was present is still true afterwards.
account_erase_your_labels: In your communities you will read as:
account_erase_owner_warning: You own a community. Transfer ownership to another member first — a community with no owner cannot be governed or closed.
